UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Authenticated learner profile, gamified Libras study progress, and application settings.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

userName.description: Display name shown on the learner profile.

completedModuleIds.description: List of completed study module IDs (max 100).

practicedSignIds.description: List of practiced Libras sign IDs (max 500).

studyDates.description: Local YYYY-MM-DD dates with study activity (max 366).

xpByDate.description: Map from YYYY-MM-DD local date to daily XP total.

settings.description: User preferences for VLibras avatar and animation speed.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last synchronized update.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Private owner-only user account, study progress, and settings document (docId = 'account').
